**Build from scratch: load up on Haaland and captain him — 5.33 xP off 0.86 xGI/90.**

**✅ What's strong**
Starting fresh with £100.0m in a 5-3-2, this squad projects a tasty 60.93-point XI haul. Haaland is the obvious armband — nailed, penalties #1, and firing. B.Fernandes (7.44 xP) is the premium midfield anchor, on pens and free-kicks, backed by Enzo (6.49) as brilliant value at £7.0m. Defensive muscle from Virgil (6.33) and Gabriel (5.83) with clean-sheet upside and attacking threat. No fitness flags to worry about — clean bill of health across the board.

**🔄 What I'd change**
Building it, so prioritise the spine: Haaland up top, B.Fernandes in midfield, Virgil at the back. Pair Haaland with Watkins (5.3) for a nailed front two. Enzo is your best mid-price differential at £7.0m, and don't sleep on Hume at £4.5m (4.86 xP) — cracking budget defender to free up funds elsewhere.

**Bottom line: Get Haaland and B.Fernandes locked in, captain the Norwegian, and let the value picks like Enzo and Hume do the heavy lifting.**
